title: The best way to add VALUE to your resume ✍️
description:
Does your resume show the skills that are most relevant for the job you're applying for? You want to make sure you're including the right skills for the job you're applying to— not everything you've ever done. So how do you know what relevant skills even are? It’s VERY easy to find those skills if you use Teal. Simply save the job with the extension then open up the role in the Job Tracker and they will be there right next to the job description. #resume #resumetips #resumekeywords #resumebuilder
